=== Proof Status ===

1 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Weighted minimum bound: let p_1, ..., p_m be positive reals with sum_i p_i = 1 and let n_1, ..., n_m be real numbers; then min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
  1.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Let a = min_{1 <= i <= m} n_i; then a <= n_i for every i in {1, ..., m}.
  1.2 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, p_i a <= p_i n_i.
  1.3 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Summing these inequalities over i gives a sum_{i=1}^m p_i <= sum_{i=1}^m p_i n_i.
  1.4 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Since sum_{i=1}^m p_i = 1, a <= sum_{i=1}^m p_i n_i.
  1.5 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Therefore min_{1 <= i <= m} n_i <= sum_{i=1}^m p_i n_i.
